name: The Unlikely Collab!

pick.label: Pick a brand
pick.heading: Pick a brand and find it a partner
lead: Fila x Chupa Chups. Crocs x KFC. Adidas x the BVG. Brand collabs used to be rare. Now two brands from completely different worlds team up every week, and somehow people queue for them.
Choose a brand from the shelf, then find it a partner that has no business being anywhere near it. Here are some ideas, but you can choose your own. *The stranger the pair, the better.*
pick.hint: Or click one to choose it.
pick.note: Obviously I am not looking for a serious brand strategy here, this is just for a bit of fun. Some collabs make total sense, and some only make sense at two in the morning. Both are welcome.

rows: Which brand did you pick from the shelf?
A second brand from a completely different world
What exactly are you selling? Give it a name.
The colours, the logo, the attitude, the thing everyone recognises…
Who wants this? Fans of one brand, fans of both, or people who just like a queue?
Where, how, and who’s first in the queue on day one?

values.product: The Ginger Sandal: bright orange cork sandals with a blue strap. They smell faintly of bubblegum. Nobody knows why, which is also true of the drink.
values.brings: Irn-Bru brings the orange-and-blue look and its cheeky Scottish humour (it once claimed to be ‘made in Scotland from girders’). Birkenstock brings comfort, and the idea that ugly can be cool.
values.who: Scottish people in Berlin pretending it’s warm enough for sandals in April, and festival-goers who want to be seen from space.
values.launch: A pop-up stall at the Mauerpark flea market on a Sunday, free cans for the first hundred people, and a very long queue that is mostly my friends.
